messages:
carla: Heads-up — our weekly crossfunc sync collides with all-hands next Tue 10:00am PT. Can we move or shorten? Also we need someone to own the agenda (RFC reviews + triage).

alex: +1 on collision. I can do Wed 10:00 or Tue 11:00 — prefer Wed.

morgan: Wed 10:00 works for me. who owns triage this week?

priya: I can own triage for 15m. I can also present the RFC about query-routing decisions if someone keeps notes. RFC link: <https://redwood.internal/rfc/query-routing>.

drew: If we move, please keep the meeting to 30m. Proposed agenda to keep it tight:
```
1) 5m quick status (infra)
2) 10m RFC: query-routing decisions (priya)
3) 10m triage + action items (priya)
4) 5m AOB
```

carla: Thanks — can we agree owners? alex = infra status, priya = RFC & triage, morgan = notes + decision log entry. @morgan please add decision-log entry after the meeting.

morgan: yep will take notes and update the decision-log doc. I'll add a minimal template entry so PMs can comment.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: Crossfunc Sync — Wed 10:00-10:30 PT. <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/12345>

alex: small ask — please add a "rollout canary check" bullet under the RFC item in case we need to greenlight canary next week.

priya: ack — will keep RFC tight and include the canary checklist. If we run out of time we'll continue async in #eng and update the decision log draft.

drew: :thumbsup:

carla: Okay locking in Wed 10:00 PT. owners: alex, priya, morgan. I'll ping product PMs for priorities now — if anyone can't make, drop a note here so we can reassign owners or record an async update.
